issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of performing the Union/Optional conversion the PR advertises
issues.detail: ruff.toml globally ignores UP007/UP035/UP045 with only 'TODO: Remove these', deferring the A | None migration this PR claims to land. Either run the auto-fix in this series or scope the ignore to specific paths so new code is held to the new shape. A blanket repo-wide ignore with no tracking issue leaves both idioms coexisting indefinitely.

issues.description: Debug 'dnf search python3.12' left in production CI install-scripts step
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep steps run 'dnf search python3.12' between update and install. It's a debugging artifact: noise in CI logs, no functional effect, and a non-zero exit would fail the job. Drop the search line and just install. The unmotivated 'dnf update -y' addition should also be justified or removed.

issues.description: default_raise shim and '<3.10 compatibility' comments left as dead scaffolding after dropping 3.9
issues.detail: wallet_request_types.py keeps default_raise() with the comment 'just for < 3.10 compatibility' and a matching block above TransactionEndpointRequest. With kw_only universally available, this is dead scaffolding whose documentation contradicts the code. Either remove the sentinel and make fields truly required, or update the rationale to state the actual current reason.

issues.description: install.sh version-range check still allows Python 3.7-3.9 while error message claims '>= 3.10'
issues.detail: The guard reads 'PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7' but the printed message says '>= 3.10 and < 3.13.0'. A 3.8 interpreter passes the numeric check and prints a contradictory message. Bump the literal to 10 so the code matches the string it prints.

issues.description: itertools.pairwise swap is correct but unrelated/under-applied
issues.detail: Replacing zip(ordered, ordered[1:]) with itertools.pairwise is a clean 3.10-unlocked simplification. But it mixes an unrelated refactor into a mechanical version-removal patch, and the same pattern likely exists elsewhere in the tree. Either split the change or grep and apply uniformly so the codebase carries one idiom.

synthesis.summary: The mechanical 3.9 removal is correctly shaped where it actually deletes version forks (cmd_classes.py is the template), but the patch is half-done. The biggest gap is ruff.toml disabling UP007/UP035/UP045 with a bare TODO, deferring the PEP 604 union migration the PR description advertises. Dead scaffolding remains in wallet_request_types.py (default_raise and '<3.10 compatibility' comments), and install.sh's numeric guard still permits 3.7-3.9 despite printing a '>= 3.10' message. CI prep gained a debug 'dnf search' line that should be dropped. NEEDS-WORK: finish the ruff conversion, strip stale compatibility shims, and align install.sh with its own error message.
